system.title: System
system.intro: Settings that apply to all call centres.
system.chunkedText: Every 15 seconds a piece of the recording is sent for transcription in the EU, and the text arrives continuously. The pieces become the call's transcription, so it is ready when the recording stops. If a piece is missing, the whole recording is transcribed instead.
system.realtimeText: The seller sees the text while the call is in progress (Soniox in the EU, temporary key in the browser). If real time drops out, pieces take over without the seller having to do anything. The stored transcription is made from the whole recording after the call.
system.bothModes: In both modes the whole recording is also uploaded continuously and stored for playback. Audio and text at Soniox are deleted as soon as the text has been fetched.
system.termsHint: One word or name per line, for example product and company names. Sent to Soniox as context.
system.aiModel: AI model for AI control and reports
system.aiModelNote: Claude via Amazon Bedrock with an EU endpoint: processed only in EU regions. Applies to calls processed after you save. The model must be enabled in Bedrock (Model access) in eu-north-1.
